definition: SAS Viya is an artificial intelligence, analytics and data management platform developed by SAS Institute.
details: SAS Viya is an artificial intelligence, analytics and data management platform developed by SAS Institute.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. That shared ruler is SAS Viya.
